run_gen_build_yaml: run the script to generate a YAML build configuration for the benchmark C++ library
summarize_gen_build_yaml: summarize the gen_build_yaml script that outputs benchmark library source and header file lists as YAML
review_gen_build_yaml: review the gen_build_yaml script that uses glob to collect benchmark .cc and .h files into a YAML config
refactor_gen_build_yaml: refactor the gen_build_yaml script to use Python 3 instead of Python 2.7
test_gen_build_yaml: test the gen_build_yaml script to verify it produces valid YAML with correct file paths
